static_traits.name: Liu Dawei
static_traits.family_status: No children; other family members not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a close friend to confide in, but rarely discusses feelings of inadequacy; shyness leads to restricted social relationships
static_traits.medical_history: No history of major physical illness; long-standing self-doubt, has not received related psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression but negative, pessimistic tone; tends to use absolute, self-labeling statements; able to cooperate in conversation but holds a skeptical attitude toward change; has excessive thinking and rumination, reports difficulty falling asleep

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe I will never be better than a children's librarian, which affects my confidence and motivation.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these negative beliefs are hindering me from realizing my full potential and achieving my goals, so I hope to change this mindset through counseling.
growth_experiences: The client has long experienced self-inadequacy and self-doubt in academic settings; this feeling has existed 'since I can remember' and has intensified in recent years; it is more easily triggered when facing challenges and opportunities, gradually affecting career and personal growth.

A few years ago, a fishing activity missed the 'big fish' due to weather, and the client regarded this experience as a 'huge failure'; afterward, in situations where similar plans were frustrated, anger, disappointment, and the thought 'why does nothing go smoothly for me' repeatedly appeared, affecting daily mood and social life.

A shy personality and appearance concerns about wearing glasses are regarded by the client as factors that 'limit potential', leading the client to avoid leadership roles and professional development opportunities at work and to have difficulty establishing and maintaining new relationships interpersonally.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/我就是失败者
My shyness and appearance will limit my potential

special_situations.event: Facing new challenges at work or opportunities for promotion/professional development
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try a new challenge, I will very likely fail, and the result will only prove I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding applying for or participating in professional development opportunities to reduce the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will surely fail too; I will not get any better than I am now

special_situations.event: Personal plans disrupted by external factors (such as weather canceling a fishing trip)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a plan is disrupted once, it means nothing goes well for me and I always fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Falling into rumination and self-blame, giving up other activities, mood remains low
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why can I not do it? Things never go smoothly for me

special_situations.event: Lying in bed at night before falling asleep, repeatedly thinking about the day's setbacks and past failures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel bad and anxious, that proves I am a failure and reality is bad too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attempts to control uncertainty through constant thinking and self-criticism, resulting in worsened insomnia
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do anything well; I am just a failure

special_situations.event: At work, needing to take on a leadership role or greater responsibility
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly be competent as a leader, it equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids taking leadership responsibilities, lowering expectations to reduce possible judgment and failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am too shy; I definitely cannot be a good leader

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be recognized and understood and to achieve self-improvement and growth (being seen and affirmed professionally and interpersonally)
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure, being evaluated or rejected, worrying this will further prove 'I am not good enough' and feeling shame
defense_goal: Reduces the possibility of failure and shame through avoiding challenges, lowering expectations, and self-deprecation, maintaining a surface sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: The self labeled by failure, not good enough (the shy person / the inadequate person)
object_relations.object_representation: Others who do not understand and may criticize or be disappointed (such as friends)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes kinder self-talk or suggests cognitive restructuring in small steps
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes these suggestions are 'unrealistic / like deceiving oneself', and that change is impossible (negation of positive possibilities)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First focus on empathizing with and validating their skeptical feelings, with a gentle tone, avoiding confrontation; use open-ended questions and jointly design small verifiable experiments, emphasizing process language of 'try - observe - summarize'.

manifestations: Generalizing a frustrated plan and one failure to 'nothing I do goes smoothly'
Pessimistic about the prospects of work and personal growth, believing 'it will never get better'
Persistent doubt about one's identity and worth, difficulty seeing effort and strengths
Friends think they are always pessimistic; the client feels misunderstood
Shyness and self-doubt lead to reduced contact with new friends and difficulty maintaining relationships
outcomes: Subjective loneliness increases, further intensifying negative self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
